Third-party code in ui/vendor/. Every file is byte-identical to the one in the named package; nothing was edited.
Loaded only through EIKON.loadVendor(name) (ui/core.js), which adds the build stamp (?v=BUILD).
To update one: new folder <name>-<version>, copy the dist file + licence from the npm tarball, check its
integrity, update this list and the path in core.js (VENDOR), bump BUILD in index.html.
